lines.en: The charging constellations flinched at the episode title that appeared in the air.
“······What's with this episode? Doesn't Hide His Strength?”
“Just kill him!”
I sighed at the weapons coming toward me.
······Damn you, Han Sooyoung.
It struck me anew: was this how a character felt?
A character who had to follow the developments the writer devised and overcome the hardships they were given.
Yoo Joonghyuk must have overcome trials like this hundreds of thousands of times.
If I had an advantage over Yoo Joonghyuk right now, it was that I knew who had written this scenario.
Swiiish!
Two streams of sword energy tore through the air before my eyes.
I dodged the attack with light footwork and thought.
Once, I had talked about something like this with Han Sooyoung.

―There are two kinds of writers in this world. Hardworking writers who plan the entire plot before they write. And genius beautiful-girl writers who work without a plan and trust their instincts in the moment.
―Which kind are you?
―Idiot. Are you asking because you really don't know?
So that genius writer had now written this damn scenario.
[Judge ‘Meihouwang’ prepares beer.]
[Judge ‘Bimawen’ prepares drip coffee.]
She was going to put me through hell while thoroughly catering to her core readership's tastes.
I looked up into the air and muttered.
“Hey, this is a deal we're making. You know that, right?”
[The scenario master tilts their head at your words.]
Whatever her reaction, Han Sooyoung would have understood what I meant.
Meanwhile, the constellations had surrounded me.
“If you've been carried this far, it's time you got off the bus.”
Getting off······ Where had these bastards learned such a frightening expression?
“We'll see which of us gets off.”
I couldn't activate [Electrification] or [Way of the Wind] here. And I couldn't use [Unbreakable Faith], either.
It would be a problem if the other beings found out I was ‘Kim Dokja’.
But at this point, I didn't need my main abilities to deal with opponents of their caliber.
Tsu-chuchuchuchut······.
Because right now, I was ‘Sun Wukong’.
[Judge ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband’ nods.]
[Use of some stigmas belonging to Judge ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband’ is permitted.]
Had I really been an ordinary constellation, I would have struggled to handle this stigma.
But I was a ‘Narrative-grade constellation’, a being who had accumulated three ‘Giant Stories’.
Kurururururung!
The sound of actual thunder, rather than someone shouting a sound effect.
The moment lightning flashed in the air, I plucked a handful of hair and blew it into the sky.
[Activating stigma ‘Body Outside Body (身外身)’!]
Body Outside Body. A body outside one's body.
Simply put, it was Sun Wukong's equivalent of the [Avatar] skill.
“Wh-what!”
“Kuaaaack!”
The Sun Wukong clones multiplied in an instant and spread in every direction, swinging brutal fists and slamming the constellations to the ground.
Narration bubbles appeared above the heads of the clones as they flew off.
(“The Demon King of Salvation!”)
(“His strength!”)
(“Doesn't hide it!”)
Apparently, she had forgotten she was supposed to be narrating.
Tsu-chuchuchuchu······.
I had only borrowed a single technique, but even that left my whole body in bad shape. It was worse because I was already unwell.
······Damn it, why the hell wasn't Yoo Joonghyuk coming out?
[Your incarnation body's recovery is delayed!]
[Your incarnation body's condition is deteriorating!]
I looked toward the lingering, thick fog and did my best to act composed.
The retired Sun Wukong had to look powerful at all costs.
And he must never reveal his full strength.
「Kim Dokja thought, ‘I am Yoo Joonghyuk.’」
Biting down hard on my lip, I put on the expression of the coolest person I knew.
“Goddamn it······ Retreat!”
The plan seemed to have worked. Intimidated, the constellations began pulling out all at once.
[Many players leave the scenario!]
In an instant, all that remained around me were the empty shells the constellations had shed.
But the shells had selves of their own.
They were the beings who originally played this world's ‘extra’ monsters.
Suddenly, my heart began beating irregularly.
[Chaos stirs in your heart.]
[Your transformation into an Outer God is accelerating.]
[Stigma ‘Fiery Golden Eyes Lv.???’ forcibly activates!]
My vision burned red, and I saw the fallen monsters.
【Whereisthiswhereisthiswhereisthis】
【A a a a a a a a】
【Againagainagainagainagainagain】
With pained expressions, the monsters were all screaming with their heads pressed against the ground. It wasn't hard to understand what was happening.
I had already seen beings like them on ‘Reincarnation Island’.

They were brought in to fill the so-called ‘shortfall in probability’ in the Story chambers of this 『Journey to the West Remake』. Expendable beings, condemned to repeat lives spent as extras in someone else's story forever.
The question was what their ‘true identities’ actually were.
[The power of chaos stirs in your heart!]
A surge of pain.
I staggered toward one of the monsters.
The moment I touched its slick body, its form changed.
A cephalopod tentacle monster.
Pages of ‘Ways of Survival’ turned in my mind.
「Some nebulae deliberately farm the cast-off shells of low-grade ‘Old Ones’.」
「They sacrifice them to bear the probability required for their scenarios.」
My heart pounded. Yes, there had been lines like that in ‘Ways of Survival’. But it had never revealed which ‘nebulae’ they were······.
Could it have been <Emperor>?
[Pilgrim Sun, stop!]

I looked up. Sure enough, one of the Heavenly Realm's constellations had descended. I wasn't sure of the name. Probably some Taibai Jinxing or Lingji Bodhisattva type again. <Emperor> had hundreds of constellations with similar names.

[Those monsters were beasts cultivating the Way at the foot of Vulture Peak! But they stole the oil beneath the glass in the Great Thunderclap Monastery, where the Buddha resides, and became monsters. Forgive them in your kindness, and give them to me······.]
Thinking of it that way, I could understand why <Emperor> was collecting these monsters.
To <Emperor>, they were a kind of resource.
A resource indispensable to running the scenarios.
[Some judges are satisfied with the fidelity to the original work.]
[You receive 5 bonus points.]
[Judge ‘Meihouwang’ yawns as though bored.]
Defeated monsters dying or returning to the immortals' possession.
It faithfully reflected the original work, a course of events that hadn't changed in thousands of years.
But if that really was the rightful course, the law of 『Journey to the West』.
【Whoamiwhoamiwhoamiwohami】
Then what meaning did these monsters' lives have?
[Judge ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband’ looks at you in puzzlement.]
When I remained silent for a long time, Lingji Bodhisattva spoke.
[Ahem. Anyway, that being so······ I may take these monsters, yes?]
In the end, the narration spoke first.
(With a nod toward Lingji Bodhisattva, Sun Wukong······.)
“I can't do that.”
(······said he couldn't do that.)
I felt the scenario master's terrifying gaze from the sky. A reproachful look, as though asking what on earth had possessed me to give that answer.
Lingji Bodhisattva was just as startled.
“You don't take proper care of them anyway, do you?”
[Wh-what are you talking about?]
“You'll just use them again as extras in another Story chamber.”
[Judge ‘Meihouwang’ watches you with great interest.]
[Judge ‘Bimawen’ closes his book and looks at you.]
[Judge ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband’ pays attention to your statement.]
Flustered by my words, Lingji Bodhisattva shouted.
[They're only monsters. You pursue a great purpose. Why concern yourself with the affairs of insignificant creatures?]

“They, too, are carrying out ‘scenarios’. You claim to seek the true path, discussing the Buddha's koans and the truths of the universe. Why are you so indifferent to the lives of those who aren't human?”
As I said that, I thought about Han Sooyoung.
Had Han Sooyoung thought of an ‘ending’ for this scenario?
[Many spectators take an interest in your statement.]

As she'd said herself, Han Sooyoung was a ‘genius writer’ who built a narrative on her instincts in the moment. But that also meant enduring the pain of creation while worrying excessively about readers' reactions every time.
[The scenario master is watching as you speak.]
Having joined the scenario in a rush, Han Sooyoung probably hadn't had enough time to plan an ending or establish a theme.
Just devising a story to excite the audience would be a struggle.
But what if I helped her?
I slowly straightened, stood in front of the monsters, and said.
“I'll take them with me.”
I saw Lingji Bodhisattva's astonished face and the confused monsters.
Some things in the world could only be seen from a writer's or reader's position. Other things could only be understood by becoming a character.
[Judge ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband’ likes your fighting spirit.]
[Judge ‘Bimawen’ likes your fighting spirit.]
[Judge ‘Meihouwang’ likes your fighting spirit.]
[150 bonus points have been added!]
[This Story chamber's theme begins to change dramatically!]
The monsters were looking up at me.
[The possibility of a new ‘Giant Story’ sprouts!]
[‘Outer Gods’ have gained shares in the new ‘Giant Story’!]
······Just as I'd expected. But the messages weren't over.
[Your promise with the Wenny King activates!]
[To fulfill the promise, you must increase the share held by ‘Outer Gods’ in this Story to at least 30%.]
[‘Outer Gods’ currently hold 0.003% of the shares in this Story.]
As that absurd percentage crushed me, Lingji Bodhisattva shouted from the sky.
[You wretch! Such outrageous arrogance! Do you think you're really Pilgrim Sun?]
Apparently forgetting his role, Lingji Bodhisattva unleashed powerful Status at me. I had just borne the probability of the Great Sage, Heaven's Equal, and I had no strength left to counter it.
Just as the wave of Status, hurtling like lightning, was about to crash down on me.
“You talk just like Dokja ajusshi, huh?”
With that voice, the lightning in the air split apart.
I looked around. The sandstorm had already subsided. My companions, approaching from a distance.
And Yoo Joonghyuk stood before me as though shielding me. Glaring at the sky, he pointed upward with [Black Heavenly Demon Sword], which had swept the electricity away with a crackle.
“I won't say it twice. Get lost.”
[Y-you bastards······ This humiliation will surely······.]
Terrified and sweating profusely, Lingji Bodhisattva vanished. Yoo Joonghyuk turned to me with a cold expression. [Black Heavenly Demon Sword] was now pointing at me.
“I told you I'd kill you if you pulled anything stupid.”
“Uh······ I'm sorry.”
“I defeated the Yellow Wind Demon King.”
“······Well done.”
I gathered up the fallen monsters one by one.
【Whoareyouwhoareyouwhoareyou】
They looked at me fearfully, then came up to my fingertips, sniffed, and fled. Hiding behind a distant tree trunk like abandoned puppies, they peered back at me.
[Some abandoned monsters follow you.]
Yoo Joonghyuk spoke.
“You know it's meaningless.”
“They'll be collected by <Emperor> again when this Story chamber ends anyway.”
“I know.”
“It's already happened to them thousands of times. Your kindness means nothing to them.”
“I know that, too.”
“They'll play the same roles in the same scenario again, and forget you. No one will remember.”
“Do those who remember nothing.”
Looking into Yoo Joonghyuk's eyes, I asked.
“Feel no sorrow?”
Yoo Joonghyuk's eyes wavered as he looked at me. I gazed at him quietly. Was it because we had reached the 94th scenario? There were quite a few scars on his face now.
Before Yoo Joonghyuk could continue, the children approached.
But looking closely, I saw that our party had gained a member.
“That's my master······ No, my senior brother here. Anyway, that was so damn cool! What was that technique? Teach me, too!”
Her lively voice made my heart ache before I knew it.
I see. You were ‘Sha Wujing’.
[‘Player 2’ has joined the party!]
“Hi, Sun Wukong. You've got quite a mouth on you, huh?”
Wearing a T-shirt with a large butterfly on it and loudly chewing bubblegum, Lee Jihye tapped my shoulder and offered her hand.
(And so, at last, the main characters of 『Journey to the West』 came into view.)
Smiling faintly, I reached out to take Lee Jihye's hand.
But suddenly, my upper body plunged as though the ground had fallen away.
“Huh? What's wrong?”
Lee Jihye hurriedly caught me as I collapsed.
Faint demonic energy seeped from my whole body, and my surroundings rapidly darkened.
[Your incarnation body is severely damaged!]
[Your transformation into an Outer God accelerates!]
[Outer God transformation progress: 71%]
It seemed my happy journey wouldn't last much longer.
「“I'll take them with me.”」
Han Sooyoung's mouth fell open as she listened to the voice coming from the panel.
A lemon candy rolling across the floor.
Lee Sookyung, who happened to be cleaning nearby, approached cautiously and asked.
“What happened?”
Still looking stunned, Han Sooyoung moved her lips.
“No, this guy······.”
She looked at the list of characters on the hologram window.
[Player 1, ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’, is playing ‘Zhu Bajie’.]
[Player 2, ‘Lee Jihye’, is playing ‘Sha Wujing’.]
[Player 3, ‘Lee Gilyoung’, is playing ‘Tang Sanzang’.]
[Player 8, ‘Watcher of Light and Darkness’, is playing ‘Sun Wukong’.]
After staring at the list for a long time, Han Sooyoung suddenly rubbed her eyelids and tilted her head back.
How much time passed?
Han Sooyoung cried “Aaaah,” then began laughing in choked bursts.
Lee Sookyung asked cautiously.
“······Flame Dragon, is that you?”
“No, no. I'm Han Sooyoung. Idiot Han Sooyoung.”
When Han Sooyoung opened her eyes again, her cheeks were faintly flushed.
And the hologram messages that followed.
[Many spectators cheer at this character's statement.]
[Some judges award bonus points for ‘Subverting a Cliché’.]
[This Story chamber is currently ranked 25th.]
“Arrogant bastard. Who asked you to help?”
As Han Sooyoung tapped the key panel, her fingers seemed to move with an odd lightness.
“Coming first is what I do best, idiot.”
A deep bitterness, like a red-ginseng decoction, filled my mouth.
As I smacked my lips unconsciously, I heard a voice.
“Huh? I think he's waking up. Try putting some of this in, too.”
Someone forced my eyelids apart and put in something like eye drops.
A cool sensation spread through my eyes, and I suddenly snapped awake.
[Consuming a new elixir accelerates your incarnation body's recovery.]
When my vision returned, I was lying on a horse's belly.
Tang Sanzang's white horse―the Chimera Dragon―snorted roughly and glared at me.
“Oh, he's awake!”
I saw Lee Gilyoung's and Shin Yoosung's worried faces brighten. Lee Jihye, who had been forcing my eyelids open, was grinning, too.
“What are we supposed to do if you're too weak even to get carried?”
“Ahem. How can someone meant to attend his master be such a weakling?”
Lee Gilyoung cleared his throat with his hands planted on his hips.
I smiled wryly and sat up, and Shin Yoosung supported me.
“Are you all right? You suddenly collapsed······.”
“I'm all right, thanks to you. But these elixirs······.”
I looked at the elixir remnants around me.
Some were unfamiliar, but I recognized others.
The eye drops in a red bottle. They were called Three-Flower Nine-Seed Ointment (三花九子膏), a treasure of Journey to the West obtainable only in the fierce battle with the Yellow Wind Demon King.
Feeling a little bewildered, I asked.
“······You used this on me?”
For a moment, I saw Yoo Sangah in Shin Yoosung's smiling face.
Three-Flower Nine-Seed Ointment. An elixir that invigorated the whole body and enhanced one's vision simply by being applied to the eyes.
[Some judges are satisfied with the fidelity to the original work!]
[10 bonus points have been added!]
Indeed, Sun Wukong was the one who used this ‘Three-Flower Nine-Seed Ointment’ in the original work.
But······ They had given me something they could have used themselves. Somehow, I felt guilty.
Suddenly, my right wrist tingled. I turned and found something terrible happening there.
“You're just as weak as that bastard. Why is your incarnation body in this state?”
Yoo Joonghyuk was taking my pulse, gripping my right wrist as though he meant to burst it. Come to think of it, he was the best at medicine after Lee Seolhwa.
Yoo Joonghyuk examined me with a deep frown.
“Not one of the meridian points in your internal organs is intact. It's a wonder you entered the scenario at all.”
“······Is that so?”
“It's rare for a constellation to end up like this. Is someone chasing you?”
Surprised, I looked at Yoo Joonghyuk.
He couldn't be asking because he was worried about me······ One hand had been clamped around the hilt of [Black Heavenly Demon Sword] all this time, so his purpose seemed clear.
“Nothing like that. I was simply in a hurry to obtain this ‘Giant Story’ and didn't have time to look after my incarnation body.”
“If you become even the slightest burden to my companions, I'll cut you down on the spot.”
Yoo Joonghyuk flung my wrist aside and stood.
“······What a waste of precious elixirs.”

Striding away, Yoo Joonghyuk sat on a nearby rock and began wiping [Black Heavenly Demon Sword] again. Having broken once, the sword seemed to have suffered considerable durability damage in a short time.
Watching him, Lee Jihye said.
“My master―no, my senior brother―is cool, right? He talks like that, but he's the one who suggested giving you the elixir.”
······That Yoo Joonghyuk?
No matter how I thought about it, I couldn't understand. Even if I had been ‘Kim Dokja’ rather than ‘Watcher of Light and Darkness’, he would······.
―He's not as cold-blooded as you think, either.
The voice of the dumpling [999], sounding in my ear.
「“Do you still think you can understand someone through a few lines of writing?”」
Those had also been the words of [999].
He was right. I knew he was right, and yet I kept forgetting that fact.
That a person's life was always larger than their story.
「Yoo Joonghyuk was always behind his companions.」
‘Ways of Survival’ had countless sentences, but they couldn't describe every moment Yoo Joonghyuk had lived through.
The 3rd turn, the 4th turn, the 5th turn······ Yoo Joonghyuk had always watched his companions from a place that far away. He had protected them there and faced their enemies.
「“Yoo Joonghyuk, did you protect everything you wanted to protect?”」
He had always failed to protect what he needed to protect.
And yet, always holding that same position.
Perhaps even if I died and came back to life, I would never understand the nature of his resolve.
Shin Yoosung approached Yoo Joonghyuk as he sharpened his sword.
“Joonghyuk ajusshi.”
Yoo Joonghyuk raised his head with his usual indifferent gaze, and the child's small hand touched his cheek. Looking closely, I saw a clear, creamy ointment spread on it.
“······What are you doing?”
“Stay still. It'll get infected. Ah, don't turn your head!”
“I don't need something like this······.”
Yoo Joonghyuk's expression grew conflicted, like that of a wild beast being tickled.
He looked ready to leap to his feet at any moment. A single person's name stopped him.
“Seolhwa unnie specifically asked me. She said you don't bother with things like this, so someone has to look after you.”
At Lee Seolhwa's name, Yoo Joonghyuk's shoulders gave a great twitch. After hesitating for a long time, he awkwardly settled back on the rock and declared in a commanding voice.
“Finish in ten seconds.”
Shin Yoosung nodded with a bright smile and enthusiastically began rubbing in the ointment.
Yoo Joonghyuk kept twitching his lips, but made no particular move to stop her.
Wherever Shin Yoosung's hand passed, Yoo Joonghyuk's wounds healed rapidly.
Lee Seolhwa's ointment really was impressive. In the original work, [Mass Production Maker] had even imported it and sold it as a cosmetic. What was it called again? Pure White Seolhwa Cream?
“Blaze, blaze.”
Hearing a mimetic word spoken aloud beside me for the first time in a while, I turned. Lee Gilyoung stood there with eyes that were, quite literally, blazing.
Lee Gilyoung's eyes darted between Yoo Joonghyuk and Shin Yoosung as though he had developed a squint.
At last, apparently having made up his mind, Lee Gilyoung stomped toward Yoo Joonghyuk and Shin Yoosung.
“Hey, Shin Yoosung!”
At his shout, Yoo Joonghyuk and Shin Yoosung looked up at Lee Gilyoung together.
Beside me, Lee Jihye was nodding with a pleased expression.
“That's right, Gilyoung. You've finally awakened.”
[Judge ‘Successor of Sakyamuni’ likes the young Sanzangs.]
[Some spectators enjoy the sight of the adorable Sanzangs.]
[20 bonus points have been added.]
After hesitating for a long time, Lee Gilyoung only moved his lips under all those gazes. He looked as though he'd acted first and now had no idea what to say.
His face red, Lee Gilyoung finally yelled.
“I'm the one who's going to put ointment on Dokja hyung!”
As though he had finally realized what he wanted to say, Lee Gilyoung added triumphantly.
“You've sided with that black-clad guy now!”
Lee Jihye had already rushed over. She smacked the back of Lee Gilyoung's head, and he fell face-first onto the ground.
“Why are you bringing up Kim Dokja now, idiot!”
Lee Jihye began lecturing Lee Gilyoung as she tugged his ear.
Shin Yoosung, shaking her head at Lee Gilyoung before going back to applying the ointment.
And Yoo Joonghyuk, rubbing his cheek over and over as though the ointment on it felt strange······.
「Kim Dokja watched it all with a quiet smile.」
[‘Fourth Wall’ grows a little thicker.]
「As though looking at a scene far away.」
The smartphone I had taken from my coat was producing sentences on its own.
Looking at the sentences appearing on it, and at my companions, I thought.
Yes, perhaps I.
「Perhaps, at that moment, Kim Dokja made a decision for the first time.」
My transformation into an Outer God accelerated. Before I knew it, 71% had become 75%, and it took only an instant to pass 80%.
But around the time it passed 85%, the increase suddenly began to stall.
It was all thanks to the elixirs my companions gave me.
“Here, eat this, too. And this.”
As though inversely proportional to the rate of my infection, my companions' clearing speed kept increasing.
Sure enough, Yoo Joonghyuk and Lee Jihye made an incredible team by the 94th scenario.
“Senior brother, over there!”
“Below.”
As master and disciple in [Breaking the Sky Swordsmanship], the two worked in perfect harmony.
Most enemies were smashed before they could approach or plot anything. Sometimes, the two even overwhelmed the original work's unfavorable matchups with sheer strength.
[Current Journey to the West progress: 43%]
[Your Story chamber's ranking has risen!]
[This Story chamber is currently ranked 21st.]
[Many spectators chant ‘Supreme King Zhu Bajie’!]
[Judge ‘Golden-bodied Arhat’ is pleased to see himself as a beautiful young swordswoman.]
Having abruptly run out of things to do, like me, Shin Yoosung muttered.
“I wish Heewon unnie and Hyunsung ajusshi had come, too.”
It seemed Jung Heewon and Lee Hyunsung hadn't been able to join us.
Lee Hyunsung probably still hadn't awakened. Having entered the final phase of [Steel Transformation], he might well sleep for quite a while. But his life wouldn't be in danger.
The real problem would come after he woke up.
Anyway, at this rate, we might finish the scenario in fewer than ten days.
A day passed, then two, then three.
[Current Journey to the West progress: 64%]
[This Story chamber is currently ranked 15th.]
[A considerable number of competitors are wary of this Story chamber.]
In that time, all I did was get carried, sleep to my heart's content, chat with my companions, and stuff myself with an enormous number of elixirs.
[Your incarnation body has recovered noticeably!]
[Your incarnation body is gradually regaining vitality.]
······My cheeks seemed to have filled out a little.
Lee Jihye, Shin Yoosung, and Lee Gilyoung watched me enjoying this comfortable life with pleased expressions.
Like farmers delighted by a pig growing nice and plump.
“This, too! Eat this, too!”
“Here, have some more.”
······Why on earth did watching me eat make them so happy?
Beside me, Lee Jihye smiled and grumbled.
“As they say, a chicken will do in place of a pheasant. It's nice to see you eating so well. If only that guy had eaten as well as you.”
Time passed again.
“Urgh! You'll pay for this, Zhu Bajie!”
A few encounters with Han Myungoh in different roles.
And we met a mysterious helper with an immortal's beard.
[Ahem. I am this mountain's spirit. I knew long ago that you had set out on a noble journey to India. So I waited here to offer you a little help······.]
The children shouted at the figure with bright blond hair and a beard plastered onto their face.
“Hayoung unnie!”
“Hayoung hyung!”
[Ahem, I'm not this Hayoung person. I was merely passing through······ Damn it, you there, Pilgrim Sun. Come and take your elixir.]
Abandoning her act, the blond immortal called me over with a complaint.
Journey to the West had plenty of contrivances like this.
[Some judges complain, asking why you had to reproduce even this detail.]
[1 bonus point has been added!]

A spirit would appear from somewhere, help the party, and say it was all the Buddha's will. The implausibility and deus ex machina were so excessive that I wondered whether Journey to the West might have been the first ‘novel that heaps every lucky encounter on its protagonist’.
I bowed politely and said.
“Thank you for helping us every time.”
[······I'm only doing it because I was told to.]
Apparently thinking of someone, Jang Hayoung looked resentfully up at the sky and muttered.
[You'd better know how lucky you are. ······Seriously, if I hadn't arrived late, the ‘Demon King of Salvation’ role—I would have······.]
As I naturally came to learn, this position had apparently been Jang Hayoung's to begin with.
“······Why did you want to be that?”
Jang Hayoung looked at me wistfully, then gave a small smile and shook her head.
[Well, of course someone like you wouldn't know. How incredible the ‘Demon King of Salvation’ is.]
After thinking for a moment, I filled my words with love for myself and said.
“I like the Demon King of Salvation very much, too.”
[Oh, really? Have you heard any of his Stories?]
“For example, ‘Liberator of the Industrial Complex’, which he gained in the Demon Realm.”
[Ooh?]
That seemed to flip a switch. Jang Hayoung suddenly launched into a long-winded speech.
Roughly summarized, it went like this.

[So, back then, I saved the dying ‘Demon King of Salvation’, see? Which makes me the Demon King of Salvation's savior, if you think about it. How's that? Fun, right? No? ······Anyway, beneath the Dark Root, we joined forces and swore an oath of brotherhood. We'd combine our strength and free the [Industrial Complex] from that devilish duke······!]
······The broad strokes were right, but why did it feel like I was hearing fiction?
[Then the ‘Demon King of Salvation’ looked at me with sorrowful eyes and said, “You, become a fighter who will gladly fight for me.”]
I wondered if it was all right for her to spout such nonsense, but messages were already filling the air.
[Judge ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband’ condemns the immortal's nonsense!]
[Judge ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband’ insists that he did the most in the Demon Realm!]
[Judge ‘Meihouwang’ laughs at ‘Prisoner of the Golden Headband’.]
[Many spectators take an interest in the Stories of nebula <Kim Dokja's Company>.]
By now, I couldn't tell whether this was 『Journey to the West』 or 『The Haphazard Grand Adventures of Kim Dokja's Company』.
Perhaps that was what Han Sooyoung was after.
The stronger the Stories of <Kim Dokja's Company> grew, the stronger the ‘Giant Story’ we would gain through 「Journey to the West Remake」 would become.
[The Stories of <Kim Dokja's Company> spread by word of mouth through <Star Stream>.]
Well, whether that was the right decision remained to be seen.
After some time, Lee Jihye yawned as though bored and spoke.
“Ah, enough already. Hurry up and give us the elixir.”
Another week passed like that.
We defeated countless monsters and again encountered constellations of <Emperor>, who appeared to collect them.
[The monsters you just defeated were ones I raised in my back garden······.]
“Get lost.”

Yoo Joonghyuk drove them off for me. Apparently unwilling to face Supreme King Zhu Bajie, the constellations of <Emperor> left obediently despite their complaints. I didn't know why Yoo Joonghyuk had taken that job upon himself, but I was grateful.
[Outer God transformation progress: 95%]
[The rate of your Outer God transformation is currently reduced.]
In that time, my transformation into an Outer God hadn't advanced much.
Our party's progress through Journey to the West, on the other hand, was astonishing.
[Current Journey to the West progress: 94%]
Progress that had finally broken into the 90% range.
Lee Jihye panted as she spoke.
“Wow, this is really hard.”
